classes: No hero class definitions in this donor. mods/default/engine/classes.txt is a commented example (points must total no more than the max available points, line 3). Real classes are in flareteam-flare-game.
Engine stats: 4 primary stats (physical, mental, offense, defense; mods/default/engine/primary_stats.txt) and 3 damage types (melee, ranged, mental; mods/default/engine/damage_types.txt line 5).

originals.name: Pull on first contact
originals.idea: When an enemy joins combat it emits a pull power that draws nearby allies in (src/EntityBehavior.cpp lines 243-245; src/Entity.cpp line 360).
originals.keep: A join-combat pull implemented as a data power, so it can be tuned per family.
originals.change: Pull only a fixed small number of allies; show a visual cue; add a cooldown. Rows: 4 (aggro and leash), 23 (zone population).

originals.name: Two-radius leash
originals.idea: An engage radius and a far radius (default twice the engage radius) so a chase ends (src/EntityBehavior.cpp line 261; src/StatBlock.cpp line 807).
originals.keep: Two radii, so the engage and the give-up distances differ.
originals.change: Reset the timer when the hero returns; show the leash on the minimap. Rows: 4.

originals.name: Pool by rarity weight
originals.idea: Enemies in a category are added to a candidate list as many times as their rarity weight (common 6, uncommon 3, rare 1), then one is picked (src/EnemyGroupManager.cpp lines 96 and 121).
originals.keep: Rarity as candidate weight, and a level window per category.
originals.change: Precompute cumulative weights once at load; use a uniform random helper; return a reference instead of copying the category vector (line 80). Rows: 23 (zone population), 18 (loot and XP).

originals.name: Two-table XP multiplier
originals.idea: XP multiplier = absolute table by enemy level times relative table by enemy-minus-hero level, clamped at the table ends (src/XPScaling.cpp lines 136-178).
originals.keep: Relative-to-hero XP, with the tables as data.
originals.change: Check the level-16 value in the data pack (31768 where the pattern gives 32768). Rows: 18 (loot and XP award).

originals.name: Per-penalty death knobs
originals.idea: Each death penalty is a separate knob under a master toggle: currency percent, total-XP percent, XP since last level percent, random item, permadeath (mods/default/engine/death_penalty.txt).
originals.keep: One knob per penalty, all in data, with a master toggle.
originals.change: Our own defaults (the default here removes 50 percent of currency and no items); a visible respawn cue. Rows: 17 (death and respawn).
